hero.title: Access coding problem data through one unified API.

hero.title: HTTP API Reference
hero.lead: Review every public non-MCP HTTP route with purpose, auth, inputs, response shape, and a copyable request example.
hero.runtime_enabled: Protected routes currently require bearer auth.
hero.runtime_disabled: Bearer auth is currently disabled for protected routes.

groups.problems_lead: Read normalized problem records, source listings, and tag metadata.
groups.discovery_lead: Resolve unknown inputs, fetch the daily challenge, and run similarity search.
groups.service_lead: Check service health and index coverage without touching admin-only surfaces.

problem_detail.title: Problem detail
problem_detail.purpose: Return a single normalized problem document.
problem_detail.auth_rule: Bearer auth follows the existing public API middleware setting.
problem_detail.success_shape: JSON object with the requested problem fields.

problem_list.title: Problem list
problem_list.purpose: List problems for a source with pagination and filtering.
problem_list.auth_rule: Bearer auth follows the existing public API middleware setting.
problem_list.inputs: Path param: {source}. Query params include pagination and optional filters.
problem_list.success_shape: JSON object with data[] and meta pagination fields.

problem_tags.title: Tags
problem_tags.purpose: List tag metadata for a supported source.
problem_tags.auth_rule: Bearer auth follows the existing public API middleware setting.

resolve_problem.title: Resolve
resolve_problem.purpose: Resolve a URL, slug, or prefixed identifier into a concrete problem.
resolve_problem.auth_rule: Bearer auth follows the existing public API middleware setting.
resolve_problem.success_shape: JSON object with source, id, and problem fields.

daily_challenge.title: Daily challenge
daily_challenge.purpose: Fetch the current daily challenge, optionally by date or domain.
daily_challenge.auth_rule: Bearer auth follows the existing public API middleware setting.
daily_challenge.inputs: Query params include domain, date, and async flags.
daily_challenge.success_shape: JSON challenge payload or accepted/fetching response.

similar_by_id.title: Similar by ID
similar_by_id.purpose: Find similar problems using an existing problem as the seed.
similar_by_id.auth_rule: Bearer auth follows the existing public API middleware setting.
similar_by_id.inputs: Path params: {source}, {id}. Optional query params refine the search.
similar_by_id.success_shape: JSON object with ranked similar-problem results.

similar_by_query.title: Similar by query
similar_by_query.purpose: Find similar problems from a free-text query.
similar_by_query.auth_rule: Bearer auth follows the existing public API middleware setting.
similar_by_query.inputs: Query params include query, limit, threshold, and source.
similar_by_query.success_shape: JSON object with ranked similar-problem results.

service_status.title: Status
service_status.purpose: Return service version and per-platform indexing stats.
service_status.auth_rule: Bearer auth follows the existing public API middleware setting.
service_status.success_shape: JSON object with version and platforms[].

service_health.title: Health
service_health.purpose: Run the public health check against the database and sqlite-vec.
service_health.success_shape: JSON object with status, db, sqlite_vec, vec_dimension, and version fields.

problem_batch.title: Batch fetch
problem_batch.purpose: Fetch multiple problems in a single request by source and ID pairs.
problem_batch.auth_rule: Bearer auth follows the existing public API middleware setting.
problem_batch.inputs: JSON body: array of {source, id} objects. Optional query param: ?detail=true for full content.
problem_batch.success_shape: JSON object with results[] and not_found[] arrays.

hero.title: MCP Reference
hero.lead: Use the mounted MCP transport when you want tool-based access to the same public problem, daily, similarity, and status capabilities.
hero.runtime_enabled: The mounted MCP transport still uses the existing bearer-auth middleware.
hero.runtime_disabled: The mounted MCP transport is currently reachable without bearer auth.

groups.transport_lead: Document the two HTTP surfaces exposed by the mounted Streamable HTTP MCP service.
groups.tools_lead: Each MCP tool maps back to an existing public REST capability while returning plain-language output for tool clients.
groups.examples_lead: Start with one connection snippet and one JSON-RPC request to verify auth, transport, and tool naming.

mcp_post.title: Streamable HTTP entrypoint
mcp_post.responsibility: Primary Streamable HTTP endpoint for initialize and tool-call requests.
mcp_post.auth_rule: Bearer auth follows the existing MCP middleware setting.

mcp_get.title: SSE session stream
mcp_get.responsibility: SSE/session-resume transport surface exposed by the mounted MCP service.
mcp_get.auth_rule: Bearer auth follows the existing MCP middleware setting.

resolve_problem.title: Resolve a problem from flexible input
resolve_problem.output_style: Text summary of the resolved problem detail.
resolve_problem.usage_note: Use when the source/ID format is uncertain or when the input is a URL.

get_problem.title: Fetch one normalized problem
get_problem.output_style: Text summary of the requested problem detail.
get_problem.usage_note: Use when the caller already knows the normalized source and problem ID.

get_daily_challenge.title: Read the current daily challenge
get_daily_challenge.output_style: Text summary of the daily challenge or the active fetch state.
get_daily_challenge.usage_note: Use when the caller wants the current daily challenge without composing REST query strings.

find_similar_problems.title: Search similar problems
find_similar_problems.output_style: Text ranking of similar problems with similarity scores.
find_similar_problems.usage_note: Use text query mode for semantic search or source+id mode for seed-problem lookup.

get_platform_status.title: Check indexed platform status
get_platform_status.output_style: Text summary of service version and platform stats.
get_platform_status.usage_note: Use for a compact operational overview of available indexed platforms.

examples.connection_lead: Point your MCP client at the mounted HTTP endpoint and send the same bearer token you use for protected public routes.
examples.request_lead: This request asks the MCP server to run the exact tool name get_problem with the same source and ID you would send to the REST detail endpoint.
